records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In fiscal year 2020, approximately 40% of our sales were outside of the U.S. We also are partners in a number of joint ventures that are involved in the manufacture and sale of flavorful products, the most significant of which is McCormick de Mexico.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Higher volume and favorable product mix increased sales by 3.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The effects of COVID-19 on consumer behavior have impacted the relative balance of at-home versus away-from-home food demand and have added volatility to our sales over the course of the pandemic.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Excluding the per share impact of special charges and transaction and integration expenses of $0.01 and $0.04, respectively, adjusted diluted earnings per share was $2.83 in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Segment operating income for our consumer segment decreased by $54.8 million, or 23.7%, in the second quarter of 2021 as compared to the second quarter of 2020.
